answers.text: Refuter: 'a trend read, not a setup; no first pullback to buy.' That is the swing system's test; WCN's picture is the position system (C26, R13): strength above a broken resistance line is the entry, not a flaw. D last_bar green, D hh_hl_3 HH/HL, W ema_order 9>21, D dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.43 = at the high, which is where my buy stop sits. H1 last_bar red is not my exit frame; C14 reads the daily candle. Not conceded.
